description: This file defines the React component 'MultiverseExplorerView' which implements a user interface for exploring multiverse career paths with filtering, bookmarking, and detailed view functionalities. It includes auxiliary functions for handling path types, filtering logic, and state management related to paths, bookmarks, and user interactions.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an input to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined inputs gracefully.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Transforms an unknown value into a string array, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given MultiversePathType.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a descriptive explanation of a given MultiversePathType.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard function to determine if a string value matches a valid MultiversePathType.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Filters a path based on search query, industry, and skills criteria.
